title: `apex/consciousness-and-agency` engages its strongest rivals below their best form: L83 asks why reasons are "the agent's" without Fischer–Ravizza's ownership condition; L101 accepts the agent's settling as a primitive while L173 asks materialism to "explain rather than redescribe"; L155 says character is "partly self-created" without addressing constitutive luck; L173's "around 60%" is uncited and taken as credit; and L125 states Kim's dichotomy without the non-reductive replies
